#129 reported ~3.3k non-autofixable trunk findings. Most were rules
mis-scoped for Reflex component code and tests, not real defects. This

plan. The minimatch advisory (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) is ignored with a
reason instead of bumped: the fix needs minimatch 11, which breaks
`@react-router/fs-routes` (no `makeRe` export).
